boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring Stony Brook traditions documented by Student Life and university news, spanning cardboard boats, campus festivals, welcome rituals, and Seawolf spirit.

cards.title: Race a cardboard boat across Roth Pond
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University spring tradition
cards.notes: Watch student teams launch handmade cardboard boats at Roth Pond, then follow the accompanying activities around this annual campus race.
cards.short_summary: A student boat race built around cardboard crafts and Roth Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: Stony Brook Student Life identifies Roth Regatta as the university’s popular boat race with student competitors and related events.
cards.access_notes: Check the university events calendar for the current spring date, participation details, and spectator access.

cards.title: Close the academic year at Brookfest
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University spring tradition
cards.notes: Look for the annual spring-concert program and its performance lineup; use the official calendar for the current venue and entry details.
cards.short_summary: An annual student-facing spring concert that marks the academic year’s close.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Life describes Brookfest as Stony Brook University’s annual spring concert for students to celebrate the end of the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Programming, performers, venue, and admission terms vary by year; confirm the official event listing.

cards.title: Join Earthstock’s sustainability week
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University spring tradition
cards.notes: Build a visit around the week’s environmental programs, choosing a sustainability, conservation, or conservation-education event from the schedule.
cards.short_summary: A week-long Stony Brook celebration of sustainability, conservation, and the environment.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Life calls Earthstock SBU’s annual celebration of sustainability, conservation, and the environment, with a week of environmental events.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current university schedule for individual event locations and any registration requirements.

cards.entity_name: Shirley Strum Kenny Student Arts Festival
cards.title: See the Shirley Strum Kenny Student Arts Festival
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University spring tradition
cards.notes: Attend a listed exhibition or performance during the month-long festival, which highlights creative work across the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A month-long campus arts celebration named for former president Shirley Strum Kenny.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Life describes the annual Shirley Strum Kenny Student Arts Festival as a month-long celebration showcasing Stony Brook students’ creative endeavors.
cards.access_notes: Students, faculty, staff, and community members are invited; verify individual program details before attending.

cards.title: Step into Wolfieland’s annual carnival
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University fall tradition
cards.notes: Find the annual carnival announcement and plan around its rides, games, food, and campus-community activities during the fall program.
cards.short_summary: A named annual carnival that puts Wolfie at the center of a campus day out.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Life describes Wolfieland as an annual Stony Brook carnival with rides, games, food, and activities for students and the campus community.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current date, location, and any ride or food charges through official event communications.

cards.title: Wear red for Wolfstock Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University fall tradition
cards.notes: Use the Homecoming schedule to choose a parade, community event, or Seawolves game moment during the annual Wolfstock celebration.
cards.short_summary: Stony Brook’s annual Homecoming celebration, organized around Seawolf pride.
cards.evidence_claim: Stony Brook identifies Wolfstock as its annual Homecoming celebration, featuring events including a parade, tailgating, and a football game.
cards.access_notes: The university lists Wolfstock for October 15–18, 2026; individual event tickets or registration may apply.

cards.title: Share the Light the Brook message
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University holiday-season tradition
cards.notes: Follow Student Life’s holiday-season programming for ways to take part in this campus reminder of care, connection, and shared humanity.
cards.short_summary: A holiday-season tradition centered on community, kindness, and inclusion.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Life says Light the Brook celebrates community, care, support, kindness, and embracing differences during the holiday season.
cards.access_notes: Review current Student Life announcements for the year’s format, activities, and public-access details.

cards.title: Catch a week of Spooky Brook
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University fall tradition
cards.notes: Check the campus event listing for the week’s Halloween-themed programs and organization-led activities, then choose an officially scheduled session.
cards.short_summary: A named annual week-long fall event with student-organization programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Life describes Spooky Brook as an annual week-long event involving Undergraduate Student Government and Student Engagement & Activities programming.
cards.access_notes: Verify current program timing, locations, and eligibility through the official campus events listing.

cards.title: Welcome the newest Seawolves
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University fall tradition
cards.notes: Look for the start-of-year welcome program, designed to help new students make connections and get oriented to university life.
cards.short_summary: A recurring start-of-year program that introduces new students to Stony Brook.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Life says New Seawolves Welcome helps new students build connections, become familiar with the university, and begin their college journey.
cards.access_notes: This program is designed for incoming students; consult Orientation and Transition Programs for current eligibility and scheduling.

cards.title: Celebrate Strawberry Fest and Diversity Day
cards.subtitle: Stony Brook University spring tradition
cards.notes: Watch for the annual spring gathering’s cultural displays and student performances, paired with strawberry-focused food and community activities.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring campus event combining strawberry dishes, cultural displays, and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: University news reported Strawberry Fest and Diversity Day as an annual event that brought the campus together through cultural displays, performances, and strawberry dishes.
cards.source_title: Strawberry Fest and Diversity Day Serve Up a Side of Fun
cards.access_notes: Check current Undergraduate Student Government and university events listings for the next date and participation terms.
